findings.finding: A second onMounted hook is added alongside the existing one. Valid Vue 3 (multiple onMounted run in order), but two onMounted blocks in one component can confuse future readers.
findings.reason: Splitting concerns (project-resolution redirect vs api-key load) is intentional and the comment explains it. Merging into the existing async onMounted would entangle the redirect/await flow with the fire-and-forget mask load. Acceptable trade-off.

findings.finding: GET response {present, mask} and POST response {apiKey, mask} match ApiKeyMaskResponse / ApiKeyGeneratedResponse exactly. apiError(e, 'projects.apiKey') resolves errors.projects.apiKey.{status}|generic, both present in uk/en.
findings.reason: Verified against backend DTOs and locale files. No issue.

summary: Clean, scoped implementation following the page's existing patterns (saveError inline error, isSubmitting-style disabled button, delete-modal markup for the show-once modal). Type-safe (no any), no plaintext persistence/logging, GET degrades gracefully. No blocking issues.
